presentation.label: EUCLID ACCENTS
presentation.summary: The euclidean generator can accent the pattern's own trigs instead of deciding which steps play: Bool Operator gains OR*, XOR*, AND* and SUB*.
presentation.overview: Euclid Accents gives the euclidean page's Bool Operator (OP) eight values instead of four: OR, XOR, AND and SUB as stock, then OR*, XOR*, AND* and SUB*. In accent mode the euclidean generator no longer decides which steps play: only the grid's trigs play, and a trig on a step where the euclidean pattern has a hit plays accented. Hand-set accents stay. Turning euclid off with FUNC held bakes the accents into the pattern; without FUNC the pattern is left as it was. The accent flag is per track, kept in core-ar2's mod storage and saved with the pattern. It is an elemod port of MrScruff's rytm-mods 0002-euclid-accents, with his code unchanged apart from the storage port.
highlights: OP gains four accent variants, OR* to SUB*.
The grid says when, euclid says what is accented.
FUNC + EUC off bakes the accents into the pattern.
The accent flag lives in core-ar2 mod storage, so stock's own bytes keep their stock values.
usage: Use a build containing Euclid Accents. Press TRIG twice for the EUCLIDEAN page, turn EUC on, and turn OP fully right: OR*, XOR*, AND*, SUB*.
Choose OR*, place a few trigs on the grid and play: only grid trigs play, and those on euclid hits are accented.
Hold FUNC and turn EUC off to write the accents into the pattern; turn it off without FUNC to leave the pattern as it was.

access.location: EUCLIDEAN page (TRIG pressed twice): the OP (Bool Operator) parameter.
steps: Press TRIG twice to open the EUCLIDEAN page and turn EUC on.
Turn OP past SUB to OR*, XOR*, AND* or SUB*.

controls.name: OP (Bool Operator)
controls.doc: Eight values: OR, XOR, AND, SUB as stock, then OR*, XOR*, AND*, SUB*, which accent the grid's trigs on euclid hits instead of adding or removing steps.

controls.name: FUNC + EUC off
controls.doc: In accent mode, bakes the accents into the pattern; EUC off without FUNC reverts.

limitations: Built for OS 1.74 only. 1.2.0 reaches its parameter through core-ar2's parameter table (core_params, core-ar2 0.4 and later; Modwerk's base is core-ar2 0.7). 1.1.0 detoured the entries of param_apply_delta and param_value_text itself, which core-ar2 0.4 and later own, so it does not link with them.
Needs core-ar2's mod storage: one bit per pattern track (euclid_accent).
On stock firmware, or a build without this module, an accent track plays as its base operator: the flag is in mod storage, which stock ignores.

load.display: Small: a few instructions and one storage read on each trig of an accent track
load.conditions: Static: two detours run per trig in the sequencer's trig fire; on an accent track the accent arm reads the track's flag through core_store_get, which masks interrupts briefly. The rest run on UI edits, drawing and the euclid bake. Not a measurement.

hardware.summary: Iced-Cream reports that on an Analog Rytm MKII with OS 1.74, euclid-accents 1.2 (this source; rytm2_mods core-pages 7ff47d7, released unchanged in v1.3) passed in P4A4, core-ar2 0.4 with all eleven rytm2_mods ports (2026-10-21): OP turned right and back through OR, XOR, AND, SUB, OR*, XOR*, AND*, SUB*, with the right glyph and label for each and the same order going back, and OP kept its accent value through a power-cycle without SAVE PROJECT. U4A4, core-ar2 0.4's final version with the same eleven objects (the bytes of rytm2_mods v1.3), passed the core's page-key steps the same day. The playback, accent level and bake checks 1.1 passed (C3A4, SXH4, EAH4) were not repeated on 1.2: 1.2 changes only how its parameter's turn and text are reached.
limitations: P4A4: .syx 1c0311697543789316c10dbbbfa78b9a717a180eb26611f2f0d1b732a428d65c. U4A4: .syx 18681f8709242b9d3c5117335a81cd5659ea01c583e3e8477d536e379517b785. Firmware was not read back from the device.
Both builds use core-ar2 0.4, not Modwerk's base (core-ar2 0.7); this package has not been flashed on its own.
The playback, accent level and bake checks 1.1 passed (C3A4, SXH4, EAH4) were not repeated on 1.2.

tests.summary: Hardware: euclid-accents 1.1's four test steps pass on an Analog Rytm MKII, OS 1.74, with core-ar2 0.3 (C3A4, 2026-10-20), and OP survives a power-cycle without a project save. Modwerk's source build gives a main OS byte-identical to elekloader's build of the rytm2_mods v1.2 release. In rytm-emu, OP turns past SUB to OR* and AND*, where stock stops at SUB.
